name: Notice of Adjournment - Parks and Recreation Commission: 1/24/2024
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT
The January 24, 2024, Regular meeting of the Parks and Recreation
Commission of the City of Artesia has been adjourned due to lack of quorum.
The next scheduled meeting will be held on April 24, 2024, to 6:00 P.M. in
the Albert 0. Little Community Center 18750 Clarkdale Ave., California
90701.

Dated: January 24, 2024

  Edith Guerra, Parks & Recreation Manager
